name: robinfund
description: Fondos sociales sobre Stock Tokens en Robinhood Chain

scripts.build: pnpm build:graph && pnpm --dir packages/agent-sdk build && pnpm --dir packages/managed-signer build && pnpm --dir packages/vault-intelligence-mcp build && pnpm --dir packages/agent-runtime build && pnpm --dir apps/agent-gateway build && pnpm --dir website build
scripts.test: pnpm test:graph && pnpm --dir apps/agent-gateway test && pnpm --dir packages/agent-sdk test && pnpm --dir packages/agent-runtime test && pnpm --dir website test && pnpm test:contracts:unit
scripts.test:graph: pnpm --dir packages/subgraph build:testnet && pnpm --dir packages/vault-intelligence-mcp test
scripts.test:uniswap:unit: pnpm --dir apps/agent-gateway exec vitest run test/uniswap.test.ts && pnpm --dir packages/agent-runtime test && forge test --root packages/contracts --match-path 'test/unit/agents/UniswapApiAdapter.t.sol'
